description: This file implements the AddressList class, which manages a collection of network endpoint addresses, including creation, duplication, alias management, and serialization for logging.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: A class representing a list of network addresses with associated DNS aliases, supporting creation, modification, serialization, and deduplication.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&)
methods.description: Constructs an AddressList with a single endpoint.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&, std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Constructs an AddressList with an endpoint and DNS aliases.

methods.name: AddressList(std::vector<IPEndPoint>)
methods.description: Constructs an AddressList from a vector of endpoints.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress(const IPAddress&, uint16_t)
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from an IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList(const IPAddressList&, std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a list of IPAddresses and DNS aliases.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo(const struct addrinfo*)
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from addrinfo linked list.

methods.name: CopyWithPort(const AddressList&, uint16_t)
methods.description: Creates a copy of an AddressList with all endpoints set to a specified port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName()
methods.description: Sets the DNS alias to the string representation of the first endpoint without port.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases(std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Sets the DNS aliases for the AddressList.

methods.name: AppendDnsAliases(std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Appends additional DNS aliases to the AddressList.

methods.name: NetLogParams()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of parameters suitable for logging.

methods.name: Deduplicate()
methods.description: Removes duplicate addresses from the list.
